# SoraButtonGroup

Groups related buttons, optionally joined into one segmented control, and gives them shared defaults.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | actions |
| Import | `import { SoraButtonGroup } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraButtonGroup from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraButtonGroup'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/actions/SoraButtonGroup.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/actions/SoraButtonGroup.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group (use `aria-labelledby` for a visible heading instead). |
| `orientation` | `SoraOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | Layout direction. |
| `attached` | `boolean` | `false` | Join the buttons into one segmented control. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Default size for buttons inside the group. |
| `variant` | `SoraVariant` |  | Default variant for buttons inside the group. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` |  | Default colour for buttons inside the group. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  |  |

## Attributes

The group `<div role="group">`.

## Keyboard

- Each button is a normal tab stop (a group is not a toolbar).

## Accessibility

- `role="group"` with `aria-label` from `label` (or pass `aria-labelledby`).

## Styling

- `.sora-button-group`
- `data-orientation`, `data-attached`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/ActionsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
  <SoraButtonGroup attached variant="outline" color="neutral" :label="t('demo.date')">
    <SoraButton :aria-pressed="view === 'day'" @click="view = 'day'">1</SoraButton>
    <SoraButton :aria-pressed="view === 'week'" @click="view = 'week'">7</SoraButton>
    <SoraButton :aria-pressed="view === 'month'" @click="view = 'month'">30</SoraButton>
  </SoraButtonGroup>
  <SoraButtonGroup size="sm" :label="t('workspace.actions')">
    <SoraButton variant="ghost" color="neutral">{{ t('demo.cancel') }}</SoraButton>
    <SoraButton>{{ t('demo.save') }}</SoraButton>
  </SoraButtonGroup>
</div>
```
